title: German Shepherd Guard Dog Saved My Pigs From Coyotes! Lets Try To Help Her Defend
description:
German Shepherd guard dog saved my pigs from coyotes attacking. I set up a cool little solar light hoping to help her defend the pigs and the homestead. Gabby has saved my wife and kids several different times over the last couple years. Best guard dog I have every owned is Gabby.
